## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Compatibility

List the oldest OS, Bash, and compiler combinations exercised by this change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `bash tests/test.sh`.
- [ ] I ran ShellCheck, or explained why it was unavailable.
- [ ] New source downloads are version-pinned and SHA-256 verified.
- [ ] The change does not require `sudo` or modify system package databases.
- [ ] The change keeps the Bash 4.2 runtime baseline, or documents why it cannot.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and limitations are documented.
